claim: At unchanged pose and velocity, the point-mass inertia and upward-positive gravitational potential increments give the external mass-event energy numerator.
assumptions: Exact integer quantities in compatible common scales; squared grip radius is fixed and inertia changes by deltaMass times that radius squared. Factors of two represent the kinetic denominator.
limitations: Does not establish browser state preservation, numerical equality, actual anatomical geometry or handling of a physical dumbbell.
numerical_evidence: Actual-arm mass-event/state tests and source-bound arm experiment receipts are required separately.

claim: A supplied zero resultant at one shared biceps guide component makes the common distal force equal the negative sum of the two head, matrix and contact contributions.
implementation: web/anatomical-apparatus.mjs and web/anatomical-contact.mjs: both biceps heads, common distal branches, sheet matrix and contact act on the same nine free guide coordinates.
assumptions: Exact signed integer force-component numerators in a compatible scale; interpolated headA, headB, distal, matrix and contact contributions are supplied; their equilibrium is assumed.
limitations: Does not derive interpolation/geometry, verify the floating-point residual, prove Newton convergence or validate an anatomical aponeurosis.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical_apparatus.test.mjs checks shared coordinates, source faces, objective derivatives and actual attachment torque; equilibrium receipts are checked separately.

claim: Reference-area child shares preserve the parent area numerator when their sum equals the parent scale.
assumptions: Exact integer compatible area/share scales; the geometric partition supplies a+b+c=scale. Positive child areas are checked numerically.
limitations: Does not prove the triangulation, positive floating-point weights, geometric clearance, continuous collision detection, Newton convergence or biological contact.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical_contact_refinement.test.mjs independently checks positive children, reference-area conservation, saved missed intersections and material-rule replay.

claim: A supplied lower unsigned distance envelope gives a gap no greater than the exact outside distance or the negative inside distance.
implementation: web/anatomical-contact.mjs: regularizedSoft; outside gap=u, inside gap=u-2*d. Raw signed distance and full geometry remain the acceptance gates.
assumptions: Exact integer distance numerators in compatible SI scales; the bound u<=d is supplied.
limitations: Does not prove the numerical simplex solver, floating-point bounds, signed-distance queries, derivative correctness, Newton convergence or collision clearance.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical_contact_differential.test.mjs checks envelope bounds/weights and tests/anatomical_contact_refinement.test.mjs checks the preserved loaded closest-face corner and original collision gates.
